unit: 1 km EPSG:6933 cell x 7-day window with >= 1 non-low-confidence VIIRS detection; windows start 2025-10-01 (both satellites in the archive)

split.policy: train = held-in regions AND window before test_from; test = held-out regions AND window from test_from; incidents are test-only

industrial_persistent.rule: cell within 1000 m of a WRI GPPD / GEM / flare-site facility AND that facility was active on >= 20% of the 365 baseline days

agricultural_burning.rule: WorldCover cropland >= 70%; Punjab / Haryana / Uttar Pradesh west of 79.5 E; window in Oct-Nov or Apr-May; no facility (any source) within 3000 m; cell episodic (< 5% active days)

vegetation_fire.rule: WorldCover tree+shrub+mangrove >= 70%; no facility (any source) within 3000 m; cell episodic (< 5% active days). NOT confirmed by MODIS MCD64A1 burned area (needs an Earthdata login) - weaker than the plan asks for

industrial_fire.rule: documented industrial fire: public source text confirms event, place and date; location resolved to a facility or industrial area; window = event date -1 d / +2 d

known_deviations: vegetation_fire is not confirmed by MODIS MCD64A1 burned area (needs an Earthdata login)
industrial_persistent uses WRI GPPD and World Bank/VIIRS Nightfire flare sites; Global Energy Monitor trackers are not loaded
agricultural_burning / vegetation_fire land cover comes from a seeded sample of candidate cells, not every cell
